_doc: UI-test av Kartrummets steg Paint (tools/studio/ui_test.py): Green isle, biomernas utbud och All, sand målad med ett riktigt musdrag (i procent, summan aldrig över 1), Ctrl som suddar, ett mönster, Undo, en närbild, Spara med lagren och ladda tillbaka. Sparar världen ui_test_paint i assets/terrain/; ta bort den efteråt.
name: paint

steps.label: the Paint step opens in the shaded view
the palette has the eight biomes, Paths and All, and starts at the biggest biome
Meadow offers five textures and Erase
with a texture the left button paints
a stroke paints sand into its own layer

steps.expect: (() => { const W = __studio.terrain.groundW; let hi = 0, over = 0; for (let k = 0; k < W.length; k += 8) { let s = 0; for (let q = 0; q < 8; q++) s += W[k + q]; if (s > 256) over++; hi = Math.max(hi, W[k]); } return over === 0 && hi > 100; })()
steps.label: the paint lies over the ground by percentage and never adds up to more than all
the footer and the drawer list the painted layer
a pattern shows its rotation and scatter
a second texture gets a second layer
Ctrl erases, back to the biomes

steps.eval: (() => { const t = __studio.terrain, f = t.field, h = 512, k = Math.round((70 + h) / f.cell) * f.n + Math.round((-40 + h) / f.cell), y = f.heights[k]; t.controls.target.set(-40, y, 70); t.camera.position.set(-40, y + 45, 140); t.controls.update(); return y; })()

steps.expect: fetch('/api/terrain').then((r) => r.json()).then((d) => { const x = d.saved.find((s) => s.name === 'ui_test_paint'); return x?.paintLayers?.[0]?.texture === 'surface_sand' && (x.layers?.groundPaint?.length ?? 0) > 100; })
steps.label: Save stores the painted layers
loading the world brings the painting back
